evals.name: Publisher ID & Script Placement
evals.prompt: Embed Google AdSense publisher script in document head with async execution and configure a responsive ad unit with client ID.
evals.expected_output: Injects official adsbygoogle.js script tag with ca-pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX syntax and responsive ins container.
assertions: Loads adsbygoogle.js asynchronously in document head
Includes crossorigin='anonymous' attribute on script tag
Configures responsive ad unit with data-ad-client and data-ad-slot

evals.name: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) Prevention
evals.prompt: Design CSS layout wrapper for an AdSense banner to reserve height dynamically and prevent Core Web Vitals CLS layout shifts.
evals.expected_output: Reserves container space using CSS min-height to eliminate content displacement when asynchronous ads render.
assertions: Declares explicit CSS min-height reservation on ad wrapper containers
Wraps ins.adsbygoogle in responsive container element
Prevents unreserved 0px starting heights during asynchronous rendering
Supports responsive leaderboard and mobile banner dimensions

evals.name: ads.txt Authorization & Mandatory Legal Disclosures
evals.prompt: Configure root ads.txt with Google canonical TAG ID and establish required Privacy Policy disclosures for third-party cookie usage.
evals.expected_output: Deploys compliant ads.txt file and publishes Privacy Policy disclosing Google AdSense, cookies, and opt-out mechanisms.
assertions: Deploys root ads.txt with format 'google.com, pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0'
Discloses Google third-party vendor advertising in Privacy Policy
Explains DART cookie usage for personalized ad targeting
Provides direct user opt-out links to Google Ads Settings
